concerns.text: FR-002 requires administering SART/Ospan via a 'web interface'. Task T011.1 implements a 'Headless Task Simulator' that explicitly avoids launching an HTTP server or browser. No task exists to implement the web interface required by FR-002.

FR-001 mandates the system recruit participants and assign IDs. Tasks T006.2, T012.0, and T012.1 only generate documentation (workflow/protocol files) and templates. No task implements the actual recruitment logic or data ingestion pipeline to register participants.

FR-009 requires a 'pre-study pilot check (n=5)' to validate task functionality. Task T009 generates synthetic data, and T019.1 is a 'proxy execution on synthetic inputs'. No task schedules a pilot check with real or simulated human-in-the-loop participants.

FR-011 requires comparing self-reported logs against 'objective screen-time data (if available)'. Task T038.1 only attempts to load a hardcoded file `data/raw/objective_screen_time.json` without any mechanism to collect or ingest objective data, rendering the comparison impossible if the file is missing.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T012.0, T012.1 vs Constitution Principle I
concerns.text: Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) requires results to be reproducible by re-running code. Tasks T012.0/T012.1 generate static documentation (`recruitment_protocol.md`) but no task implements the executable logic to enforce protocol rules (e.g., consent verification) during data ingestion.

Task T054 duplicates the dependency check logic described in T031 (both verify `data/processed/compliance_scores.csv` existence in `merge_data.py`). This indicates a stale or redundant task entry that should be consolidated.
